resources.string: A new session forks off before this message and sends it again. This session stays as it is. Files on the Mac are not rewound.
A new session forks off before this message, with the message in the composer. This session stays as it is. Files on the Mac are not rewound.
Stop pi before you fork this session.
The fork started, but the message could not be sent again. Send it from the composer.
Attachments are not carried over. Add them again if you need them.
The fork started, but your Mac could not confirm whether the message was sent again. Wait for the reply before sending anything.
